metadata.scenario: A parent urgently seeks medical advice for their child experiencing a sudden allergic reaction. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Edward Martinez. I need urgent help—my son is having an allergic reaction. Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear that, Edward. Can you tell me more about his symptoms? Well, he's breaking out in hives and has difficulty breathing. I don’t know what to do! It sounds serious. Have you called emergency services? It’s very important to get immediate medical attention. I haven’t yet, but I’m worried. Should I take him to the hospital? Yes, if he’s having trouble breathing, please call 911 right away. Do you need any assistance in calling? No, I can do that. I just need to know what else I should do. While waiting for help, try to keep him calm and sitting up. If he has an EpiPen, use it immediately. He does have one! I’ll give it to him now. Thank you! You’re doing great, Edward. After this, we can discuss any follow-up care options you might need. Yes, please. I want to make sure he has everything he needs after this. Absolutely. Once things settle down, you can call me back, and we can review what services we offer, including medication management. That would be helpful. I’d like to know more about medication management, especially with his allergies. Of course! It can help keep track of his medications. Just remember, safety first—call 911 immediately. I’m doing that right now. Thank you for your help, Margaret. You’re very welcome, Edward. Please stay safe, and don’t hesitate to call back for any follow-ups. I will. Thank you again! Take care, Edward. Goodbye! Goodbye!
